recognize_zh: 骨小樑內有一個被挖空的吸收腔（Howship's lacuna / tunnelling），腔壁整圈排列著多核、胞質粉紅的蝕骨細胞（osteoclasts），腔內為疏鬆纖維性基質，這種「隧道狀骨吸收合併旁小樑纖維化」是副甲狀腺亢進／腎性骨病變（osteitis fibrosa）的典型表現。
features: Thick bony trabecula with a central resorption cavity (tunnelling/dissecting resorption)
Cavity lined circumferentially by numerous large multinucleated osteoclasts with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm sitting in scalloped Howship's lacunae
Cavity filled with loose, pale fibrillary/edematous fibrous stroma containing scattered small cells
Adjacent marrow at lower left with fat cells and hematopoietic elements
Paratrabecular loose fibrous tissue along the right trabecular surface
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section (photographed through the eyepiece) shows a thick bony trabecula containing a large internal resorption cavity. The cavity is lined circumferentially by numerous multinucleated osteoclasts occupying scalloped Howship's lacunae and is filled with loose fibrous stroma, representing dissecting (tunnelling) resorption. Adjacent paratrabecular loose fibrosis is present, and the nearby marrow contains fat and hematopoietic cells. In a patient with chronic renal failure, the findings are consistent with renal osteodystrophy with secondary hyperparathyroidism (osteitis fibrosa).

ddx.vs: Bone histology is identical; separation relies on serum calcium (high in primary, low-normal in secondary) and renal function.
Paget disease has very large osteoclasts with many nuclei plus a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines and osteoblastic rimming, rather than tunnelling resorption with paratrabecular fibrosis.
Tumor-associated osteolysis shows osteoclasts adjacent to sheets of plasma cells or carcinoma cells, not a cavity filled by bland fibrous stroma.
Myelofibrosis shows diffuse reticulin/collagen fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters and osteosclerosis rather than osteoclast-rich resorption cavities.
